header: The register of clashes: lines where two readings are possible, and what the planner says about each. This is data, not code; every row is an assertion in records.selftest.ts. I add a clash found in live use as one more row. `expect` is a domain, "ask" (two readings are close: nothing is suggested, the reader chooses) or null (only text: the bar's usual paths decide).
